add_pointrend_config: add PointRend configuration options to a Detectron2 CfgNode for mask refinement via point-based rendering
configure_point_head: configure the POINT_HEAD CfgNode with training point count, oversampling ratio, and subdivision steps for inference
configure_implicit_pointrend: configure the IMPLICIT_POINTREND CfgNode with image feature and positional encoding toggles plus L2 regularization
configure_roi_mask_head: configure the ROI_MASK_HEAD feature maps, FC dimensions, and output resolution for coarse mask predictions
configure_input_augmentation: configure input crop single category max area and SSD color augmentation for semantic segmentation training
